parallels.note: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

people.name: Hamul
people.line: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah.

people.name: Hezron
people.line: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah, ancestor of David.

people.name: Perez
people.line: Son of Judah, ancestor of David and Jesus

translations.web: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
translations.bsb: And these were the descendants of Perez: the Hezronite clan from Hezron and the Hamulite clan from Hamul.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
translations.asv: And the sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
